title: test: allow realistic permission integration latency
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Gives three full-Worker permission integration tests a 15-second test budget instead of Vitest's 5-second unit-test default.
- Runs the Recraft catalog and rejection requests concurrently.
- Changes no runtime behavior, retries, provider timeouts, or production safeguards.

Observed failure: the production runner timed out these tests while 2,293 others passed.

Tests: permission suite 20/20 passed; Gen typecheck; Biome.

gist.headline: Tests Get Breathing Room
gist.blurb: Three full-Worker permission checks now get a realistic 15-second budget, and two Recraft requests pollinate in parallel. The production runner can stop mistaking patient integration tests for broken ones.
gist.summary: Updated three full-Worker permission integration tests in gen.pollinations.ai from Vitest’s 5-second default to a 15-second budget and ran Recraft catalog and rejection requests concurrently, reducing false production-runner timeouts without changing runtime behavior.
gist.impact: Contributors get a more reliable permission test suite: all 20 checks retain the same production safeguards while slower full-Worker requests have time to finish.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny stopwatch, tends a cozy garden of permission-test sprouts beside a retro terminal; two Recraft request packets travel along parallel vine paths toward a glowing 15-second hourglass. This represents realistic integration-test timing and concurrent requests, not a production feature.
